description: OMENZ Payment Doctor: why was my x402 payment refused, whose side is it on, and how do I fix it? Send the 402's PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, the payment you sent and/or the error text (or just the URL). Checks format, version, amount, payTo, asset, time window and known facilitator errors, incl. the >500-char description rejection. CAUSE_FOUND / NO_PROBLEM_FOUND, fix per cause. Stores nothing. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/pay/doctor, $0.002 via x402.)
